parameters.name: organization
parameters.description:
Specifies the organization. The value that you specify for this parameter indicates how the operation applies to an organization(s). Some parts of the Fortinet Endpoint Protection and Response Platform system have separate, non shared data that is organization-specific. Other parts of the system have data that is shared by all organizations. The value that you specify for the organization parameter, as described below, determines to which organization(s) an operation applies:
•	Exact organization name – Specifies the name of a specific organization. The value that you specify here must match exactly.
•	All organizations – Indicates that the operation applies to all organizations. In this case, the same data is shared by all organizations.

parameters.name: osFamilies
parameters.description: Specifies the list of operating system families: Windows, Windows Server or OS X

parameters.name: pageNumber
parameters.description: An integer used for paging that indicates the required page number

parameters.name: showExpired
parameters.description: Specifies whether to include collectors which have been disconnected for more than 30 days (sequentially) and are marked as Expired

parameters.name: sorting
parameters.description: Specifies a list of strings in JSON format representing the fields by which to sort the results in the following format: %7B"column1":true, "column2":false%7D. True indicates to sort in descending order.Results are sorted by the first field, then by the second field and so on

parameters.name: states
parameters.description:
Specifies the list of collector states: Running, Disconnected, Disabled, Degraded, 
Pending Reboot, Isolated, Expired, Migrated or Pending Migration

parameters.name: strictMode
parameters.description: A true/false parameter indicating whether to perform strict matching on the search parameters. The default is False

parameters.name: versions
parameters.description: Specifies the list of collector versions

put.description: This API call move collector between groups for EMS integration

parameters.name: collectorIds
parameters.description: value = Array of collectors Ids. To move collectors from one organization to another

parameters.name: collectorSIDs
parameters.description: value = Array of collectors SIDS. To move collectors from one organization to another

parameters.name: collectors
parameters.description: Array of collectors names. To move collectors from one organization to another, for each collector please add the organization name before the collector name (<organization-name>//<collector-name>)

parameters.name: forceAssign
parameters.description: Indicates whether to force the assignment even if the organization of the target Collector group is under migration
